tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, a cool grey one step below `panel` so cards lift off it. Dark is a soft charcoal, not near-black. Text on it: `text` 13.9:1 light / 13.5:1 dark, `text-2` 6.8 / 9.1, `muted` 5.3 / 6.3.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: sidebar, HOT cards, track lists, review card, comments, secondary buttons, unselected chips, the segmented-control thumb, the `.tag` fill. Always paired with a `shadow-*` token (or, on `.tag`, a `line` ring). Text on it: `text` 15.5:1 light / 11.8:1 dark, `text-2` 7.6 / 8.0, `muted` 5.9 / 5.6.

tokens.name: panel-alt
tokens.usage: Quiet fill on top of `panel`: row hover, ghost-button, chip and sidebar-link hover, album-art placeholder. 1.14:1 on `panel` in light (a hover you can see), 1.14:1 in dark. Text on it: `text` 13.6:1 light / 10.3:1 dark, `text-2` 6.6 / 7.0, `muted` 5.2 / 4.9; focus ring 4.0 / 5.8.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Ground of every inset well: search pill, `.field`, `.field-area`, the service segmented control. A step below `bg`. `text` 13.2:1 light / 14.8:1 dark; placeholder `muted` 5.0 / 7.0.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines only: the `.tag` ring, so a label keeps an edge on `bg` (1.2:1 on `bg`, 1.3:1 on `panel` light). Never text, never a focus or state cue.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `panel`, `panel-alt`, `field`, `music-soft`: at least 13.2:1 light / 10.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text that is read in full: sidebar links, unselected chips and page numbers, review excerpt, auth links, `.tag` label, review author, the wordmark's `.KR`. At least 6.4:1 light / 7.0:1 dark on every ground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta text: dates and the dot before them, counts, sort links, sidebar group heads, track numbers and durations, artist line, placeholders, IP tag, wordmark tails. At least 5.0:1 light / 4.8:1 dark on `bg`, `panel`, `panel-alt`, `field`; 4.7:1 light / 4.8:1 dark on `music-soft` (the playing row's artist line).

tokens.name: muted-2
tokens.usage: Decorative only: the reply thread elbow, the hover underline of sort links, scrollbar thumb, the cover's idle bars in light (via `cover-bar`). 1.9:1 light / 2.5:1 dark on `bg`. Never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: music
tokens.usage: Brand blue as a FILL only (the #3182F6 hue one step deeper so white passes): start of `accent-gradient`, the 공지 notice label, light-theme focus ring. `on-accent` on it 4.7:1 light / 4.9:1 dark. Not text and not a mark in dark (2.7:1 on `panel`): use `music-ink` for text and `music-mark` for marks.

tokens.name: music-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed start of the write/submit button gradient (`linear-gradient(135deg, music-hover 10%, accent-hover)` in bundle.css), so a hovered primary button darkens instead of lightening. `on-accent` on it 5.8:1 light / 5.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: music-ink
tokens.usage: Blue as TEXT and small glyphs: selected chip, board link and page, playing-track title and bars, recommend button, search-key hover. On `music-soft` 5.35:1 light / 5.8:1 dark; on `bg` 6.0 / 7.6; on `panel` 6.7 / 6.7. The segmented control's thumb stays in `text`: its raised shape carries the state.

tokens.name: music-soft
tokens.usage: The one selected-state fill: active genre chip, sidebar board, current page, playing track row; also the recommend-button hover. Always carries a 1px `music-line` inner edge and `music-ink` text at weight 800 (plus the bar mark on a playing row), so selection never rests on hue alone. Light is a clear tint step darker than `bg` (1.12:1) so a flat selected pill reads as chosen, not as a raised idle chip. Text on it: `music-ink` 5.35:1 light / 5.8:1 dark, `text` 12.4 / 10.3, `muted` 4.7 / 4.8. The edge is inset and 1px, so it never reads as the 2px offset focus outline.

tokens.name: music-line
tokens.usage: 1px inner edge (inset box-shadow) of the `music-soft` selected fill: selected chip, sidebar board, current page, playing row. 1.54:1 light / 2.0:1 dark on `bg`, 1.37:1 light on its own fill. Never text, never focus.

tokens.name: music-mark
tokens.usage: Bright blue for non-text marks and big shapes: the active sort underline, the wordmark gradient start, the cover's slab and playing bar. Light (`music`) 4.1:1 on `bg`, 4.6 on `panel`, 4.0 on `panel-alt`, 3.9 on `field`; dark at least 3.8:1 on `bg`, `panel`, `panel-alt` (UI needs 3:1).

tokens.name: special
tokens.usage: Alias of `music`; kept because the source replaced a former purple with the UI blue. Use `music` in new work.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand violet as a FILL only: end of `accent-gradient`, the cover's second block. `on-accent` on it 5.7:1 light / 5.1:1 dark. Not text: use `accent-ink`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed end of the write/submit button gradient (paired with `music-hover`). `on-accent` on it 7.1:1 light / 6.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Violet as TEXT, reserved for community highlights: HOT eyebrow and its bars, the 글쓴이 label, star ratings. At least 5.9:1 light / 5.4:1 dark on every ground, 6.1 / 6.1 on `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: accent-mark
tokens.usage: Violet for marks: the end of the wordmark sweep (`.brand-word`). Light is the brand violet itself, 5.5:1 on the header; dark is a saturated lavender, 5.0:1 on the header and 5.6:1 on `bg`, so the violet half of the pair still shows. Not for body text: use `accent-ink`.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the 글쓴이 label (6px-radius tag, never a pill). Violet marks highlights; blue `music-soft` marks selection. The two never swap.

tokens.name: admin
tokens.usage: Danger as a FILL: delete button, 관리자 badge, danger-button hover. `on-accent` on it 5.8:1 light / 4.7:1 dark. Not text in dark (3.3:1): use `admin-ink`. Hover never lightens it: use `admin-hover`.

tokens.name: admin-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the delete button (`.btn-admin-delete`): one step darker than `admin`, so the white label rises on hover instead of dropping. `on-accent` on it 7.1:1 light / 6.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: admin-ink
tokens.usage: Danger as TEXT and outline: the 회원 탈퇴 outline button, dislike, report hover, list comment count. At least 4.8:1 light / 4.7:1 dark on every ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on every brand fill (`accent-gradient` and its hover gradient, `music`, `accent`, `admin`, `music-hover`, `accent-hover`, `admin-hover`) and the logo bars: one white in both themes. At least 4.7:1 on every fill in both themes; hovers only darken, so a hovered label is at least 5.8:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, drawn with `outline` on every link, button and field so it survives forced-colours mode. The search pill takes it only while its input is focused; the segmented tabs draw it 2px inset (no room in the 4px well), sort links at a 4px offset (clear of the underline). At least 3.6:1 light / 5.8:1 dark on `bg`, `panel`, `panel-alt`, `field`, `music-soft` (light: 4.1 on `bg`, 3.9 on `field`, 3.6 on `music-soft`).

tokens.name: sh-light
tokens.usage: Reference ink of the highlight in the resolved shadow tokens (the top-edge hairline: 0.9 alpha light, 0.05 dark). Not consumed as a variable: the shadow tokens carry it resolved with alpha, and style.css keeps its own bare `r,g,b` triplets for `rgba(var(--sh-light), a)`.

tokens.name: sh-dark
tokens.usage: Reference ink of the ambient drop in the resolved shadow tokens: navy-tinted in light so shadows stay cool, black in dark. Not consumed as a variable: the shadow tokens carry it resolved with alpha, and style.css keeps its own bare `r,g,b` triplets.

tokens.name: panel-glass
tokens.usage: Sticky header fill (`panel` at 88%) under `backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(12px)`, as `.site-header` implements.

tokens.name: apple-fill
tokens.usage: Sign in with Apple fill (`.apple-btn`), per Apple's guidelines: black on the light theme, white on the dark theme. Third-party spec; never used outside that button.

tokens.name: apple-ink
tokens.usage: Label on `apple-fill` (`.apple-btn`): 21:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: cover-ink
tokens.usage: Cover only: the ink block. Light is `text`; dark is a lifted slate at 1.6:1 on `bg`, so the block still reads while the name stays the brightest mass. Idle bars (`cover-bar`) on it 4.0:1 dark, the `music-mark` bar 3.1:1.

tokens.name: cover-bar
tokens.usage: Cover only: idle equalizer bars on `cover-ink`: `muted-2` in light (7.3:1 on the `text` block), `muted` in dark (4.0:1 on the slate block). Decorative, never text.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The header wordmark (`.brand`): capitals D U L I at 1.15em/900, -0.8px, in one `music-mark` to `accent-mark` sweep; tails (o, ike, ndie) 13px/600 set tight against their capital, and `.KR` at 1em/700, both in `text-2`, so the mark uses two inks: the sweep and `text-2`. Groups sit 0.18em (4px) apart, wider than any capital-to-tail join, so it reads D·o U L·ike I·ndie.KR.

styles.name: board-title
styles.usage: Board name above the list (`.board-title-row h1`), baseline-aligned with the sort control: the first thing the eye hits under the header.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Review card title (`.rc-title`), album name in a post (`.view-album-name`).

styles.name: list-title
styles.usage: HOT card title (`.widget-title`, 2-line clamp, keep-all). The recommended-song title uses it at 15px.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Base `body` text. Every style inherits -0.2px tracking; titles tighten further.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Comment text (`.ci-content`), review excerpt (`.rc-content`, `text-2`), album track names (`.ad-track-name`, 500), single-line inputs.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Every button label (40px buttons), genre chips (600 idle, 800 selected), sort links, page numbers. Sidebar links use it at 500. The large submit button (등록, 44px) uses it at 15px/800.

styles.name: control-sm
styles.usage: Small controls and bylines: service segmented tabs, the search key, comment and review authors (`.ci-meta`, `.rc-author`), review stars (800).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sidebar group heads (`.cat-head`, `muted`), comment actions (`.ci-actions`), track numbers (600, `muted`).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, counts, artist line, track durations, the IP tag (`.ci-date`, `.widget-stats`, `.rec-track-artist`, `.ad-track-dur`, `.ip-tag`): always `muted` or darker, weight 500 so small Korean text does not thin out; tabular numerals.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Every 20px label: `.tag`, `.notice-badge`, `.team-badge`, `.admin-post-badge`, `.ci-op-badge`; 6px corners (`radius-xs`), so a label never looks like a pressable pill. 12px/700, not 11/800, so dense syllables (쓴, 관) stay open. Labels carry no outer margin toward what follows; the context sets it.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: HOT eyebrow (`.hot-badge`): `accent-ink` text led by the logo's three bars (15x12 mask), no fill. 12px like every other label, stat and date; 800 and open tracking make it the loudest small text without going smaller.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Labels: `.tag`, notice/team/admin badges, the 글쓴이 label; focus corners of bare text buttons. The square-ish corner says 'this describes', not 'press me'.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Fields and small tiles: logo badge, both form fields (`.field` and `.field-area`, so a stacked form shares one corner and inset), album art in lists, the cover's bars (half their 24px width). Nothing pressable uses it.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Mid containers in the site stylesheet: album cover and images in a post, embedded video, search results, the dropdown panel. The component bundle does not use it: panels in one column share `radius-lg`, and rows inside them use `radius-lg` minus `space-2` (16px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large containers: sidebar, HOT cards, review card, comments and replies, track lists, post table, modals; the cover blocks. Rows inside an 8px-padded container (track rows, sidebar links) take calc(radius-lg - space-2) = 16px, so their corners stay concentric with it.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Everything pressable, plus the search bar (a query field joined to its 검색 key, so it reads as one control): all 40px buttons, the 48px Kakao and Apple sign-in keys, genre chips, the service segmented control and its tabs, page numbers (36px circles), search pill and key, auth links. Form fields you fill in (`.field`, `.field-area`) take `radius-sm`; labels take `radius-xs`.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Every gap and padding in bundle.css uses these steps; control heights are fixed at 32 / 36 / 40 / 44 / 48.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: segmented-control inset and tab gap, HOT bars to label, sidebar row gap and the group head's bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips and header actions; comment meta gap and the space around its date dot; tracklist tray and sidebar padding; row vertical padding; the 공지 label's gap before a title in a post list.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Title-to-meta gap in cards, row horizontal padding, comment-list gap, sidebar link padding, stats gap, textarea vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The content column's stack step: board title row → genre chips → service picker → track trays all 16px apart. Also the HOT card grid gap, the break between sidebar groups, genre chip and small-button padding, comment vertical padding, header vertical padding, field and textarea horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of every card (HOT, review) and comment horizontal padding, so text in one column starts 20px in; button horizontal padding, page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Recommend-button padding, the showcase reply indent (2 x the 12px thread elbow), the cover's bottom inset (the blocks and the name share the 264px line).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Sidebar-to-content column gap (shared by header and shell grid), page top padding, submit-button padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections (HOT row to board title).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of the page and of long forms.

shadow.note: Soft single-direction light: an ambient drop straight down, a 1px hairline ring and a top highlight. Light shadows are navy-tinted (`sh-dark`); dark ones are black with a faint white ring so edges still read on charcoal.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Small raised controls: genre chips, secondary and recommend buttons, the search key, the segmented-control thumb, page-number hover, the reply comment. Dark rim at 10% white (1.37:1 on `bg`), so a `panel` key keeps its edge on the charcoal page.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting state of every `panel` container: sidebar, HOT cards, track lists, review card, comments.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hover lift of cards (with translateY(-2px)), dropdown panel, modals, album cover in detail.

tokens.name: shadow-header
tokens.usage: Sticky header: a hairline bottom edge plus a soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Large wells: the post textarea (`.field-area`), and the pressed (:active) state of filled buttons. The 13% navy rim (1.34:1 on `bg`) keeps a light well's edge on the page, so a field never reads as a disabled slab.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-sm
tokens.usage: Small wells on `field`: search pill, `.field`, the service segmented control; pressed state of raised keys. Same 13% navy rim as `shadow-inset` in light.

tokens.name: shadow-art
tokens.usage: Album art in lists (`.rec-track-art`): a short 'record sleeve' drop, lighter than a card's so a pale cover never sits on a grey smudge. Dark adds a 16% white rim (1.6:1 on `music-soft` and on `panel`), so a dark sleeve keeps a visible edge on the playing row and on an idle row; light needs no rim.

tokens.name: shadow-fill
tokens.usage: Solid non-brand fills: delete button, Kakao and Apple sign-in, a selected chip filled with its team colour.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: 'Lit key' for anything filled with `accent-gradient` (logo badge, write/submit buttons): `shadow-fill`'s neutral drop (navy in light, black in dark) with a brighter 1px top highlight. The gradient carries the colour; the shadow never tints, so there is no halo.

gradient.note: Theme-aware in bundle.css as linear-gradient(135deg, var(--music) 10%, var(--accent)).

tokens.name: accent-gradient
tokens.usage: Light-theme value (dark runs #2B6BE0 to #7A4DF0). FILLS only, always under `on-accent`: logo badge, write/submit buttons (hover swaps to `music-hover` → `accent-hover`). The wordmark capitals use their own `music-mark` to `accent-mark` sweep; nothing else is gradient, and the bundle ships no gradient-text utility.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Film-grain dither consumed by the site stylesheet (style.css `body::after`, `opacity:var(--grain-opacity)`); the component bundle draws no grain. 0: single-direction shadows no longer band. One value only; style.css keeps its own dark override.

tokens.name: disabled-opacity
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (`.page-btn:disabled`, disabled buttons): the whole control at 40%, cursor default, no shadow. Exempt from contrast minimums; never the only cue for a state that must be read.
